create.title: Exact lower signed Farey row and microscopic-resonance reduction
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), y=floor(sqrt X), N=floor X, L_chi(T)=sum_(g<=T)chi_4(g)/g, and c_(a,b)=L_chi(y/b)V_low(4R^2a^2/b^2)/a on the literal reduced support 2<=b<=y, b odd, 1<=a<b, (a,b)=1. Put theta_(a,b)=Na/b and phi_(a,b)=Na/b+(b-1)/4 mod 1. The exact integerized lower cone is F_N=sum_(a,b)c_(a,b)e(phi_(a,b)); the original X-phase cone differs by the accepted O(R) seam. The complete same-denominator block is O(y log^2(2X)). One ordinary carrier fibre and one physical carrier fibre have l1 mass O(tau(N)log(2X)), and either delta-collision collar has ordered absolute mass O(y tau(N)log^2(2X)(1+delta y^2)). Hence, if R_delta is the signed cross-denominator sum with both carrier distances greater than delta, then |F_N|^2=R_(y^(-2))+O_epsilon(yX^epsilon). The target |F_N|<<_epsilon RX^epsilon is equivalent, after epsilon renaming, to |R_(y^(-2))|<<_epsilon yX^epsilon. This residual estimate is not proved and its absolute capacity remains y^(2+o(1)).
create.next_action: Prove the prescribed-centre signed bound for the exact cross-denominator residual with both carrier distances greater than y^(-2). Keep the literal coefficient, primitive numerator, determinant, both carriers, and all boundary owners joint.

create.title: Lower signed Farey determinant, Poisson, radical, and self-return obstruction
create.statement_tex: For b=Gr, b'=Gs, (r,s)=1, Delta=G delta_0 with delta_0=as-a'r, all solutions are a=a_0+r ell and a'=a'_0+s ell; the determinant phase and chi_4(Gr)chi_4(Gs)=chi_4(rs) are constant in ell. The partial fraction 1/(aa')=(s/a'-r/a)/delta_0 retains unavoidable endpoint/aspect terms; the variable odd-S reciprocal-kernel family rules out an aspect-free 1/|delta_0| gain. Exact character Poisson on the inclusive hard d<=y interval retains a half-endpoint and all dual integrals. Its interior stationary principal factor is e(-1/8)N^(1/4)chi_4(r)(hr)^(-3/4)V_low(R^2hr/N)e(sqrt(Nhr)), with absolute capacity O(R^(3/2)log(2X)), versus target R. If N=Ds^2 with D squarefree, the unique exact variable-phase-one channel is hr=Dt^2 and has principal/transition absolute mass O_epsilon(RD^(-3/4)X^epsilon). Near radicals and every nonprincipal owner remain open. Fourth-power packets show target-scale residual capacity, paired tubes show R^(3/2) post-modulus capacity, and a second Legendre or exact Fourier transform returns the original reciprocal or flat-discrepancy interface. These are scoped controls, not target bounds or physical lower bounds.
create.next_action: Park determinantwise modulus, uniform adjacent-character pairing, principal-only Poisson replacement, exact-radical sufficiency, fourth-power lower-bound claims, and repeated-transform gains. Reopen only with an owner-complete signed mechanism for the exact residual.
